answer: The canyon explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the terrace binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 3 separate vaults requires a separate funded grove account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Each impostor pays 5 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
